event_name: Anna Goeldi executed — last European witch execution
significance: Anna Goeldi of Glarus, Switzerland, was judicially executed on June 13, 1782, in the last documented judicial execution for witchcraft in early modern Europe; her case was officially recorded as a poisoning case to avoid the embarrassment of a witchcraft charge, but contemporaries understood it as a de facto witch execution, and the Swiss parliament issued a formal rehabilitation in 2007.
source_method: Glarus cantonal court records; analyzed in Hutton, The Witch (2017) and Levack, The Witch-Hunt in Early Modern Europe (2006)
